chk_inventory_receipts_supplier_client_e.name: chk_inventory_receipts_supplier_client_exclusive
chk_inventory_receipts_supplier_client_e.value: NOT (supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.name: chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign
chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.value:
(type IN ('RECEIPT', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'PRODUCTION_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN') AND quantity > 0)
          OR (type IN ('ISSUE', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'PRODUCTION_OUT', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT') AND quantity < 0)

chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range.name: chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range
chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range.value: lot_size_max IS NULL OR lot_size_max >= lot_size_min

chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_pair.name: chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_pair
chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_pair.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR (sort_ok_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ok_qty >= 0 AND sort_ng_qty >= 0)

chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_require.name: chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_requires_sort
chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_require.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR disposition = 'SORT'

chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_total.name: chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_total
chk_quality_inspections_sort_qty_total.value: sort_ok_qty IS NULL OR sort_ok_qty + sort_ng_qty = quantity

chk_quality_inspections_supplier_client_.name: chk_quality_inspections_supplier_client_exclusive
chk_quality_inspections_supplier_client_.value: NOT (supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_quality_inspections_oqc_no_iqc_field.name: chk_quality_inspections_oqc_no_iqc_fields
chk_quality_inspections_oqc_no_iqc_field.value:
inspection_type <> 'OQC' OR (
        reason IS NULL AND inspection_standard IS NULL AND inspector_name IS NULL
        AND measuring_tools IS NULL AND qc_department_id IS NULL
        AND sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL
      )

chk_quality_inspections_oqc_job.name: chk_quality_inspections_oqc_job
chk_quality_inspections_oqc_job.value: inspection_type <> 'OQC' OR (production_job_id IS NOT NULL AND production_job_operation_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_quality_inspections_decision_in_use.name: chk_quality_inspections_decision_in_use
chk_quality_inspections_decision_in_use.value: decision IS NULL OR decision IN ('PASS','FAIL')

chk_quality_inspection_results_ac_re_ord.name: chk_quality_inspection_results_ac_re_order
chk_quality_inspection_results_ac_re_ord.value: acceptance_number IS NULL OR rejection_number > acceptance_number

chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.name: chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_total
chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.value: sort_ok_qty IS NULL OR sort_ok_qty + sort_ng_qty = quantity

chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.name: chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_pair
chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR (sort_ok_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ok_qty >= 0 AND sort_ng_qty >= 0)

chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.name: chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_requires_sort
chk_quality_inspection_results_sort_qty_.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR disposition = 'SORT'

chk_production_orders_status_fields.name: chk_production_orders_status_fields
chk_production_orders_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND code IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'APPROVED' AND code IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)
          OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND code IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_jobs_status_fields.name: chk_production_jobs_status_fields
chk_production_jobs_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND started_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'WAITING_QC' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'WAITING_DELIVERY' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_job_issues_qty.name: chk_production_job_issues_qty
chk_production_job_issues_qty.value: (unit_qty IS NULL OR unit_qty > 0) AND required_qty > 0
